subject: Alignment: promptset acceptance criteria + contingency for regression
messages:
From: Brooke Lane <brooke@acme-analytics.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-09T14:12:00Z
Subject: Initial pass: acceptance thresholds for PromptSet v3

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our engineering team wants to proceed with a short A/B to validate PromptSet v3 in production, but we need to lock acceptance criteria and a fallback before we start. Short list of asks: 

- What exact metrics you recommend we use for "no-regression" (e.g., Rouge/EM, semantic-similarity thresholds, hallucination rate sampling frequency)?
- Minimum sample size and run duration you recommend for an A/B that will be meaningful for our support volume (~6k queries/day)
- A clear rollback/fallback plan in case we see a quality regression during rollout

Attached is a sample promptset and our internal MAP (priorities) to help you scope. Can we get a proposal by next Wednesday?

Brooke
Senior Product Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: promptset_v3.json (application/json)
Attachment: MAP_proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Brooke Lane <brooke@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-10T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial pass: acceptance thresholds for PromptSet v3

Thanks Brooke — high level response inlined below, and we can turn this into a short SOW if helpful.

Metrics we recommend:
- End-to-end semantic agreement (embedding cosine) on curated eval set >= 0.82 mean; track 5th percentile as lower bound.
- Hallucination sampling: random audit of 200 responses/day during the canary period; red flag if >3% critical hallucinations by human review.
- Production side metric: support-ticket-trigger rate (rate of follow-ups or clarifications) — relative increase should be < 7% vs baseline.

Sample size & duration:
- For 6k q/day, run a 7-day canary at 10% traffic (~4.2k queries sampled) gives reasonable signal for major regressions.
- If you want tighter confidence on small delta detection, increase to 20% for 14 days.

Fallback plan (short):
1) Auto-fallback: route new requests to current-v2 for the route if latency/error spike or canary quality SLO breached (we can configure threshold triggers).
2) Manual rollback: stop v3 rollout and revert routing policy (safest for business-critical routes).
3) Hotfix path: deploy a prompt tweak + evaluation run on staging, then thin canary.

I've attached a one-page acceptance matrix and a suggested canary schedule. Next steps: we (Redwood) draft a short runbook + Notion page with automated alert thresholds; would you like Redwood to own the rollback action or do you prefer Acme control?

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Product Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: acceptance_matrix.csv (csv)

- Can we get concrete alert definitions (metric, window, threshold) that will live in the route dashboard? Connor suggested 5th percentile embedding and hallu-rate — we should tie those to specific Grafana alerts.
- For the 7-day 10% canary, we need to pre-configure a hot-path for immediate rollback (route toggle + threshold-based auto-fallback) that does not require multiple approvals. Let's define who is authorized to flip the toggle.
- Confirm data retention and log access for their SOC requirements (Acme asked about evidence for audits).

I'll draft a short ops checklist and propose owners.

-Marissa

Folks — building on Connor/Marissa: here's a compact acceptance matrix I think will operationalize the proposal.

Acceptance matrix (summary):
- Pass: embedding mean >= 0.82 AND 5th percentile >= 0.68 AND critical-hallu <= 3% on sampled audits.
- Soft-fail (requires human review): embedding mean between 0.78 - 0.82 OR critical-hallu between 3% - 6% -> pause increase, open immediate triage, run prompt-level ablation.
- Fail: embedding mean < 0.78 OR critical-hallu > 6% -> auto-fallback to v2 and incident.

Operational notes:
- Sampleing strategy: 200/day random + stratified sample on high-risk intents (support routes)
- Canary thresholds implemented as Grafana alert rules and routed to the on-call and product ops channel; set auto-fallback rule to trigger on Fail.

I'll attach the CSV with the matrix and suggested ticket templates for triage. I nominate Marissa + Rishi as rollback authorities for the initial run; we can expand after the first week.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Applied ML / Evaluation, Redwood Inference
